implementation: Readable schema v1 adapters reproduce a user-owned root factory and named injection seams without rewriting project source. The generated module remains importable using normal Python paths and runtime dependencies.

Schema v2 lowers persisted variant edits to readable Python: built-in Layer add/set/replace/remove, ordered transactions, share-selected and clone-selected across native Sequential, ModuleList and ModuleDict containers. Active cursor, variant seed and per-operation initialization seeds are honored.

The CLI validates and replays the selected variant before generation, rejects unsupported provider/component edit recipes before creating output, prevents traversal/symlink/overwrite writes, and reports the selected variant revision.
Generated variant adapters can be used as normal training entrypoints; source snapshot, export and independent restore include the adapter and imported project modules.
